headline: Every sector falls on Anthropic's big day
context: An early rally faded after Anthropic's stock market debut, and selling spread across the market as investors cooled on AI stocks.
chart_title: Every sector fell, energy the least

PANW.text: Results beat forecasts: profit per share of $1.05 vs $0.97 expected. It also raised its full-year sales forecast.

OKTA.text: No company news. Security stocks rallied for a second day, lifted by Palo Alto's higher forecast.

P.text: The data storage firm's results beat forecasts, with profit per share $0.08 above estimates. It also raised its yearly sales forecast.

WSM.text: Profit only just beat forecasts, sales fell slightly short, and it kept its yearly forecast unchanged.

TWLO.text: No company news. It fell with the wider tech sell-off, as software peers Microsoft and ServiceNow also dropped.

AMD.text: Fell after Hunterbrook, which bets against it, claimed its chips reached a blacklisted Chinese firm.

watch.title: Inflation and GDP data
watch.text: PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, plus a revised growth figure for Q3.

watch.title: Thanksgiving closure
watch.text: US stock markets shut for the holiday, then open for a half day on Friday.
